Photographing balanced and energised @annataeuber and @polxzo for @karma_supply 🧘‍♀️

Purple light, green shadows, and two women who trusted me completely with their bodies in motion - this yoga session outside in Vienna turned into one of my favorite shoots this year 🧘‍♀️

Huge thanks to @karma_supply for the trust, and to my amazing models @polxzo and @annataeuber for stepping onto the mat with confidence, joy and light energy.

If you’re into yoga or sport in general - go check out @karma_supply - their outfits swing from clean, plain colours to seriously outstanding designs made for Kali’s badass warriors.

Shooting outside in public locations in Vienna isn’t always easy - light changes, people walk through, plans shift. But that’s exactly the kind of chaos I love working with. When things get unpredictable, that’s when the best frames happen.

Yoga has been part of my routine for a while now - it brings me clarity, and shooting it felt personal in a way that doesn’t happen often. Also, not gonna lie: this was one of the smoothest sessions I’ve directed, models just flowed and I chased the light.

This is the kind of work I want more of - athletes, yogis, sports brands who want images that actually capture movement and energy, not just posed shots. If that’s you or your brand - my DMs are open 📩

How do you like it? Let me know below 💖

August 24 marks 35 years of Ukraine’s independence

In Vienna, we had the chance to celebrate it in both Ukrainian and German, right in the heart of the city - Maria-Theresien-Platz. The event brought together Ukrainian artists, businesses and the wider community for a day to celebrate, recharge and unite.

Among all the outstanding musical talent, capturing the incredible @leleka_music and @yar_dzhus on stage was a particularly special experience - the energy, the music, and the connection with the audience made it a moment worth remembering. 

Very thankful to have been part of it and to have captured a little piece of the celebration - thanks to @umiz_europa and @ukrainian.embassy.vienna for making it happen 🇺🇦

Villa photography workshop (~ retreat with the camera) by @dasha_kucher that got me from the first sip of coffee in the empty garden ☕️

Quiet morning in the nature, sitting on the grass under the willow with early sun playing on my skin and birds chipping away in the breeze. This is my reload, even a couple of minutes will do, as the day ahead was about to be all about art in action, getting inspired alongside my colleagues. 

The workshop, designed and curated by Darya, was organised as a self-reflection through a variety of photography practices. We started with theory on trends in presenting the photography work and immersing the viewer into our vision digitally. Then we created still life and photographed it with instant print cameras and polaroids, and after we brought our developed polaroids onto paper and meditated when making our own mixed media art - with vintage pattern makers, acrylic paint, crayons, stickers. So funny how in our digital world putting any device aside and touching some paper gives momentary oxytocin release. This practice made me question what would I create once I sit with my thoughts, what do I want to make with no purpose other than the act of creating itself. And the act of creating - its value - is deliberately derived from the process itself and the level at which I am diving in and switching from thinking to feeling. 

And, of course, we photographed a lot. The locations and the extraordinary styling of our model - @uraaruu - were set by Darya, together with makeup & hair by @daryadoesmakeup . In one day, the ladies styled 4 outfits in 4 different setups, with varying makeup, even though our plan was a tad shifted by the rain. 

Thank you @dasha_kucher for the amazing day at the villa and a great learning experience 🩶

Check out the results in my feed 👽

Hope you had fun 😘 Your emoji just picked your photo approach for July 📸🧨 Details: 

Landscape: This summer your challenge is to see the place - whether your vacation spot or your own town - through a new prism, find the angle you didn’t know exist. 

Details: The big picture is good to know, medium makes us closer but the devil is in the details. Show us every crumb of that delicious croissant, every spark on that dress, get even closer with your viewer. 

Video: Capturing images is one thing, but this July your challenge is to show us the process, the adventure behind the shot, the hill you climbed before you saw the view. 

Still life: The composition of your routine, the natural or artificial setup of items that inspire you - we want it all, your challenge is nature morte - but 2026. 

Portraits: Heat outside or not, these summer outfits and these blue skies will not capture themselves - so grab your friends (they want pictures too) and embark on a journey of hot sunny July portraiture. 

Wilderness: Hi there city cat, this July you have to step out of concrete and under the shade of trees - touch some grass - observe the ecosystem left aside from our human hustle. And tell us the story of this adventure. 

Whether you’re a photographer or not, we are all creative souls and need to express ourselves, and I hope this little game made you laugh at least a bit and maybe gave you a little push to create more this July.

Part 2 is more minimalistic, classy and with a pinch of black & white Hollywood (which always comes up in my mind when I see @cathleeene smile). I was aiming at capturing her emotions, the state of flow and peace found in the moment, and of course getting a glimpse of her grace and her warmest smile. 

I believe the results are a movie of their own.

“Too much of me standing in my own way”

@annaoncall embodying the state when you’re frozen, still in one’s own thoughts - and oh my, there can be so many perspectives to press onto me when I have to make a decision. It’s a whole village in there, discussing the outcomes of any particular decision, their voices stratifying and burying the truthful feeling deeper within. 

Stepping aside from this state created these images in my mind - the space where the many me’s of the situation are rattling through their perspectives, while the inner voice is always looking exactly at the needed path. 

Hope you found joy in these works

Try 1, Volume 1: Red

The empowering, anxious, arousing. Starting with letter A, spicy, hot, dangerous. Warning. Hinting about the potential danger. So tempting to press the red button. To get furious. The explosive colour. Signalling of the ripeness. Of the riches. Of depth or burning surface. Making any decision faster. The colour of stopping and speeding. Driving the light. 

Reminder of bloody danger and the aliveness of the blood in our veins. 

The one we paint passion with. 

Thank you for stepping into my red experiment 🔴
